fields.impact: Claims reject with a network timeout for all payers. E-prescriptions arrive late or not at all.
workaround: Ask the patient for the insurance card and write the group and member numbers on the downtime form.
Triage the line: insulin, anticoagulants, children antibiotics and inhalers first.
For a critical medication, offer a cash price or a short emergency supply; do not hold it for a claim.
Call prescribers whose e-prescriptions have not arrived and take verbal orders for new prescriptions.
Log every manual fill on the downtime form for rebilling when the switch returns.
fields.cashPolicy: Offer the patient the cash price or a wait; do not hold a critical medication for a claim.
fields.emergencySupply: Up to a three-day supply for a chronic medication when the pharmacist cannot reach the prescriber; document and notify the district manager.
